subject: Renewal: procurement exception & onboarding credential refresh

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>

Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, Sep 8, 2026 at 9:12 AM -0700
Subject: Renewal: procurement exception & onboarding credential refresh

Hi Emily —

Quick note on Central Med's upcoming renewal (RDW-4821). The customer wants to add a +30% capacity uplift effective at renewal and needs the vendor onboarding credentials refreshed in your procurement portal before legal can sign. Their security team also flagged that the current vendor record shows our older EIN/address; that needs to be reconciled to avoid a portal rejection.

We have a hard go-live on the expanded capacity for a product trial on 10/04. Given the timing, can we request a temporary procurement exception to accept a signed PO by email while your internal credential update completes? If an exception lane is possible, we will upload the signed PO and SOW to the portal immediately afterward.

Attached: Redwood_SOW_v2.pdf (PDF, 1.2MB)

Ask: Please confirm the required fields for the PO and who the approvers are so we can route internally. If you prefer, I can submit the CentralMed questionnaire now and have our legal/finance owners looped.

Thanks — appreciate a quick read.

—Logan
Logan Wright
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
logan.wright@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0134
From: Emily Santos <emily.santos@centralmed.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, Sep 8, 2026 at 11:03 AM -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal: procurement exception & onboarding credential refresh

Hi Logan —

Thanks for the heads-up. Two things from procurement/security:

1) We need a completed procurement questionnaire (I attached our standard file) with EIN and vendor contact details to refresh the record.
2) If you request an exception to accept a signed PO outside the portal, we need the business justification + approval from our Finance Director (cc'd Danielle Reeve on procurement exceptions). Exceptions over $50k are reviewed twice.

I attached the questionnaire: CentralMed_Procure_Questionnaire.xlsx (Excel). Please fill the sections on tax ID and remittance address exactly as they appear on vendor invoices.

If you can submit the completed questionnaire and a filled PO template, I can open an expedited exception review with Finance. Once I have the uploaded docs I will route for sign-off; approval ETA is typically 48–72 hours for an expedited lane.

Logan/Jordan —

If Central Med needs a +30% uplift in time for 10/04, we should push the exception hard and pre-clear finance. A few internal notes:

- Thresholds: anything > $200k needs Director-level signoff from Finance and Legal redline review. If the renewal and uplift push the ARR past that, loop Eva in (Legal).
- Evidence: the questionnaire + a filled PO template is the minimum to start an exception review. Make sure EIN, W9, and remittance address match our vendor portal metadata exactly.
- Escalation: if procurement requests vendor attestations, add our compliance engineer (Jordan) to answer technical questions about data residency/retention.

Action: Logan, fill the questionnaire and the PO template today and ping Emily. I will approve the business justification email for the exception once I see the completed docs.

—Kimberly Park
Head of Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com

Emily / Danielle —

Thanks — attached is the completed questionnaire and our PO template. Per Kimberly's note, the uplift moves the 12‑month commit to $168,400 (30% uplift over current). Business justification: Central Med is running an expanded pilot that requires the extra GPU capacity for real‑time inference during patient intake workflows; a missed go‑live will delay clinical evaluation.

Attachments: CentralMed_Procure_Questionnaire.xlsx (completed), Renewal_PO_Template.docx (filled)

DocuSign link for the SOW + PO (signed by customer): https://docusign.com/embedded/abc123

Please confirm receipt and let us know if the exception lane has been opened. If Finance needs any additional backup, Kimberly will send the formal approval email.
